intent: A sunken jarl's grave armour in dark tarnished bronze: a bone-crested nasal helm with a narrow shadowed eye slit, a moss-grown fur mantle edged in worn bronze rim plates, bronze lames and long dark mail tails; from the high camera it reads as a bone-topped bronze helm over green fur shoulders above a mould-black body.
requests: A fur material distinct from Fabric, so the moss-grown mantle reads as fur up close as well as at the high camera.
